name: GPU Voxelization
definition: A GPU-based voxelization pipeline using a vertex, geometry, and fragment shader to rasterize triangles into a voxel list. It uses atomic counters to handle concurrent writes.
summary: GPU Voxelization maps 3D triangle meshes to a voxel grid by leveraging the GPU's hardware rasterization pipeline and atomic operations for concurrent writes, distinguishing it from CPU-based approaches.
